verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API (localhost, offline), an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to read/search/modify Objects via natural language, plus an 'Agents' skill for scripts/bulk edits with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI etc., and a headless CLI/server mode — directly satisfying headless read/write without GUI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP/API actually working reliably, and no OpenAPI spec discoverable (probe found 404s) limiting third-party validation.
